an3.87:1.1: bhikkhave diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha atthakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.
an3.87:1.2: Tisso imā bhikkhave sikkhā yatth' etaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati.
an3.87:1.5: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso sikkhā yatth' etaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati. 2.
an3.87:2.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattaso kārī.
an3.87:2.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.87:2.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.87:2.5: Yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.87:2.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattuparamo hoti
an3.87:2.7: sattakkhattuparamaṃ deve ca mānuse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsāritvā dukkhassa antaṃ karoti.
an3.87:2.8: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā kolaṅkolo hoti dve vā tīṇi vā kulāni sandhāvitvā saṃsāritvā dukkhassa antaṃ karoti.
an3.87:2.9: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti ekaṃ yeva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhassa antaṃ karoti.
an3.87:2.10: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassa antaṃ karoti. 3.
an3.87:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya mattasokārī.
an3.87:3.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.87:3.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.87:3.5: Yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.87:3.6: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
an3.87:3.7: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sasaṅkhāra-parinibbāyī hoti.
an3.87:3.8: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
an3.87:3.9: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti.
an3.87:3.10: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti. 4.
an3.87:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī.
an3.87:4.2: So yāni tāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati pi vuṭṭhāti pi.
an3.87:4.4: Na hi m' ettha bhikkhave abhabbatā vuttā.
an3.87:4.5: Yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyikāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an3.87:4.6: So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.87:5.1: Iti kho bhikkhave padesaṃ padesakārī ārādheti paripūraṃ paripūrakārī. Avañjhāni tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sikkhāpadāni vadāmī ti. 87. 1.
